name: 终极地狱2008完整版
english_description: Ultimate Hell 2008: Complete Edition ('Revive of Ultra Hell (Blood & Magic)', originally from 1999.11.13, produced by CDS). Part of this collection's wider 'Doing'/Hell-lineage family rooted in the hell archive — its master.lpc, logind.lpc, named.lpc, and versiond.lpc are structured almost line-for-line the same. A byte-level, line-ending-normalized comparison of the /d room tree confirms the shared world runs deeper than the engine files: this build is 88% identical to hell's own map, and even closer to its own zjdy-branded siblings — 95% to zjdyaryl, 90% to zjdyzj, and 76% to both zjdywzb and zjmudhell — so all six archives (hell, zjdy2008wzb, zjdyaryl, zjdywzb, zjdyzj, zjmudhell) are snapshots/variants of one authored wuxia world rather than independently-designed games. This edition's own distinguishing touches: registration splits surname and given name into separate prompts and adds an explicit 1-5 character-type menu, new characters start from 'Peach Blossom Spring' (世外桃源) rather than the more common south-city inn, and the sect map includes 'Dragon Slaying' (屠龙) and 'Blood Blade' (血刀) rooms nodding to specific Jin Yong weapons/factions alongside the standard Shaolin/Wudang/Emei/Beggars'-Sect/Mingjiao roster.
